{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u076/system/state/workspace/programs/task-0d594af8.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def intervals(n, separators):
        spans = []
        start = 0
        for x in separators + [n]:
            if start < x:
                spans.append((start, x))
            start = x + 1
        return spans
    rs, cs = intervals(h, sep_rows), intervals(w, sep_cols)
    # The ordinary cell color is the most frequent non-marker color in the panels.
    panel_values = []
    for r0, r1 in rs:
        for c0, c1 in cs:
            panel_values.extend(grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(panel_values)
    marker = 5 if 5 in counts else max(counts, key=counts.get)
    background = max((v for v in counts if v != marker), key=lambda v: counts[v], default=0)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in rs:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in cs:
            nmark = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if nmark > 1 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
